replay.scratch_requirement: Use an executable disk-backed target-c985 scratch directory; /tmp is tmpfs and /tmp/persistent is noexec.
replay.command_template: TMPDIR=<disk-backed-target-c985-scratch> nix shell nixpkgs#cargo-mutants --command cargo mutants --profile campaign --all-features --baseline skip --copy-target false -j 2 -F completion_lower_bound_exceeds -C=--lib -C=<test-filter> -o <output-dir>

assurance_boundary: The reference table protects exact theorem-strength semantics, including safe weakening regressions; the independently enumerated subset-completion oracle separately checks that every production prune is sound. Mutation testing does not itself prove the mathematical lower-bound theorem.
